items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1961-02-16
items.q: that's what Mr. Pan used to do, snare drum

ctx.x: Yeah, how about the time beats that you use on the street, say the 6-8? You play the same sort of beats as you play in the 6-8 dance band things, like Gellysburg and whatnot. You play

Gellysburg and if you play the 6-8, you got that regular military beat, you know, that's the 6-8 two beats on the bass drum. You should play your syml even with the bass drum beats, because it looks, it's out of order to take the player, you're playing da-da-da-da-da-da, like that, it's more after beats, but you play the same beat with your bass and cymbals like a man doing, playing a regular military band.
